If not, then the fleeting light cannot resist the eternal darkness, and all withers into nothingness at the end of time.
The rules among the stars dictate that nature must be conserved, but the laws of the universe have never been conserved.
In a sealed box, destruction always overpowers new life. Millennia upon millennia of prosperity are but an instant in a span of billions of years. The greatest of achievements, the proudest accomplishments, in time all will tarnish, decay, dissipate, and ultimately fade into oblivion.
Thus there are things floating in among the stars, once adorned with countless prestigious titles from innumerable civilizations, shedding tears for their ordained demise.
Their tears stream down, out of desperation, out of hope, because all desperation and hope alike will be utterly extinguished along with the innumerable stars.
Their tears stream down out of sorrow, out of joy, because both will eventually scatter into the cold, dark endless void.
Every tiny yet beautiful silhouette and every moment worth remembering will fade with time, even stars.
And then there are these so-called "gods" that are determined to save everything worth saving, and devour everything that should be devoured.
Until the end of time, until the sea of stars recess into nothing but dying embers, until a newborn "world" moves for the first time in the stomach of the whale.
"There will be no more sins, no more sadness, and no more tears, because everything died with the ancient stars."

129002.name: Obsidian Ancient Name
129002.description:
An Ancient Name, Tumaini, forged after many twists and turns, whose meaning is "hope."
You are its first bearer, and it shall record all your deeds and adventures in Natlan, to be passed down forevermore.
"Wisdom" is not the sole domain of living things, nor are all memories or emotions a "blessing." It is a nameless, shapeless existence, nor can common sense comprehend it. Just as we know naught about places that no light may touch, we cannot be sure that there are not countless pairs of eyes watching us from the deepest reaches of the dark. It is a condescending thing that lusts after the knowledge and information stored in the land. Even the horror and despair, which humans can never transcend, are mere emotions "simulated" for your benefit once it has understood all that Natlan is.
Lend your ear to Xumucul's roar. Hear the hatred that festered in the heart of the unrivaled warrior a thousand years ago. How he regrets lifting his weapon before the tombs of his companions in days bygone! For if this battle could never have been won, then he was no leader, but a cruel, lonesome king.
Look upon the tears of Cochanina — witness her thousand-year-old despair. Resolute she was to the end, but fire, sword, and death never ceased to ravage her homeland. At the last, she would kneel before the icy coffins, and reflect upon the image the rain-puddles painted of her: If it cannot be rejected, why not embrace it?
Feel Ndenge's fury, and know his thousand-year madness. He fought for Natlan all his life, shed and spent his fiery blood, only to learn the truth of war from the Sacred Flame once he had attained the throne. He was not a hero, beloved by all — he was but a blind, ignorant clown, for humanity can never hope to conquer the true master.
Fathom the words of Xbalanque, perceive his thousand-year-old lie. The utmost wisdom births the utmost paranoia, and as he held time and death in his hands, he doomed Natlan to an endgame without any solution. Humans need not light lamps before the destined darkness to come, lest it be to attract still larger monsters.
Think upon Mavuika's plan... No.
It can warp history and memory, but it cannot twist your personal experiences. This is the meaning of this name you hold, and the light that Ancient Names mean to pass down.
"Our forebears carved 'miracles' into obsidian rock, yet future bearers looked upon them and saw 'strength.'"

129003.name: Moon-Prayer Blossom From Columbina
129003.description: A Moon-Prayer Blossom gifted to you by Columbina, exuding a fragrance both pure and ethereal, much like those you once saw in the Silvermoon Hall.\nIt stirs the memory of a story, and heralds the opening of a new chapter. This time, it will never lose its colors again.

140001.name: Wings of First Flight
140001.description: A stylized wind glider that bears the passionate longing of an Outrider.
sources: Obtained after completing the Mondstadt Archon Quest "City of Freedom"

140002.name: Wings of Companionship
140002.description: A stylized wind glider upon which is inscribed the wish to soar together.

140003.name: Wings of Descension
140003.description: Only available while playing on "PlayStation™Network".\nA stylized wind glider that can be used to cross the celestial heights.
sources: Special reward given to players on "PlayStation™Network"

140004.name: Wings of Azure Wind
140004.description: A stylized wind glider gifted to you as a mark of Mondstadt's acknowledgment and recognition.
sources: Reward for reaching a certain Reputation Level in Mondstadt

140005.name: Wings of Golden Flight
140005.description: A stylized wind glider gifted to you as a mark of Liyue's acknowledgment and recognition.
sources: Reward for reaching a certain Reputation Level in Liyue

140006.name: Wings of Concealing Snow
140006.description: A stylized wind glider left behind by a bird of prey that once soared among these mountains.
sources: Reward for reaching a certain level of Frostbearing Tree Offering

140007.name: Wings of Feasting
140007.description: A pair of wings that memorialize great banquets or ordinary dinners. All the enjoyment of a feast, for the price of a simple meal.

140008.name: Wings of the Stormstrider
140008.description: A stylized wind glider gifted to you as a mark of Inazuma's acknowledgment and recognition.
sources: Reward for reaching a certain Reputation Level in Inazuma

140009.name: Wings of Shimmering Galaxy
140009.description: A stylized wind glider and a gift that celebrates a symphony that resounds across the stars.

140010.name: Wings of the Forest
140010.description: A stylized wind glider gifted to you as a mark of Sumeru's acknowledgment and recognition.
sources: Reward for reaching a certain Reputation Level in Sumeru

140011.name: Wings of the Starlit Feast
140011.description: A stylized wind glider and a gift that celebrates a festival witnessed in a distant world.

140012.name: Wings of Merciful, Wrathful Waters
140012.description: A stylized wind glider gifted to you as a mark of Fontaine's acknowledgment and recognition.
sources: Reward for reaching a certain Reputation Level in Fontaine

140013.name: Wings of Transient Dreams
140013.description: A stylized wind glider, one that you obtained in a trance-like flash as you entered a dream of the past through music.

140014.name: Wings of Delicacies
140014.description: A wind glider that commemorates the reopening of a grand feast. Not seen for many years, yes, but is the taste unchanged? Assuredly so.

140015.name: Wings of Soaring Flame
140015.description: A stylized wind glider gifted to you as a mark of Natlan's acknowledgment and recognition.
sources: Reward for fulfilling certain Tribal Reputation condition(s) in Natlan

140016.name: Wings of Fate's Course Intertwined
140016.description: A stylized wind glider. Twice we intersected, parted, and were reunited.

140017.name: Wings of the Silent Moon
140017.description: A stylized wind glider gifted to you as a mark of the Welkin Moon's acknowledgment and recognition.
sources: Obtained from completing all quests under "Selenic Chronicles: Part III"

140018.name: Wings of Leisurely Moments
140018.description: A stylized wind glider created to commemorate a leisurely meal — one of countless interwoven moments of everyday joy.

140019.name: Wings of Starry Winterfrost
140019.description: A stylized wind glider gifted to you as a mark of Snezhnaya's acknowledgment and recognition.
sources: Obtained from completing all quests under "Secret Tsarist Assignment: Part II"

200007.name: Xiao Lantern Flight Manual
200007.description: A handbook issued by the Ministry of Civil Affairs, detailing special techniques for releasing Xiao Lanterns. By following its instructions, you may be able to launch the lanterns in a unique Xiao Lantern formation.

220001.name: Anemoculus Resonance Stone
220001.description: A stone that can be used in Mondstadt to search for nearby Anemoculi.\nThis man-made stone plate possesses a certain characteristic similar to that of the Anemo Statues of The Seven, giving it the power to resonate with Anemoculi.\nOculus Resonance Stones are crude imitations of the Statues of The Seven constructed by the ancients. But it is precisely this crudeness that makes them crave the power of elemental oculi, thus providing devout worshippers and adventurers alike a prime opportunity to collect oculi.

220002.name: Geoculus Resonance Stone
220002.description: A stone that can be used in Liyue to search for nearby Geoculi.\nThis exquisite stone plate imitates a certain mysterious quality of the Geo Statues of The Seven, causing it to lead people to the location of Geoculi.\nElemental Oculi represent the lost power of the Statues of The Seven — perhaps offering this power back to the statues also has significance for the lands that the gods watch over.

220003.name: Geo Treasure Compass
220003.description: A compass that can be used in Liyue to search for nearby treasure and relevant clues.\nThe land of Geo is rich with valuable resources, with treasures hidden throughout the mountains and wilderness just waiting to be found.

220004.name: Wind Catcher
220004.description: A bottle that is able to hold Anemograna and use their energy to generate wind currents.\nThis item was designed by Knights of Favonius scholars to help the Knights on their scouting expeditions and travels by affording them the ability to better use the blessings of the Anemo God.\nIn order to take advantage of its wind currents with a wind glider, you technically need a gliding license — this has prevented it from becoming widely used, at least legally anyway.

220005.name: Portable Waypoint
220005.description: Use this to create a temporary Teleport Waypoint at your current location. Only one can exist at a time.\nA pocket-sized item that creates a temporary Teleport Waypoint. It is capable of connecting with the ley lines, at least to the extent necessary to bring about teleportation.\nAlthough it offers an incredible convenience to Vision bearers, the actual principles behind Teleport Waypoints are not yet fully understood. We can only hope that using them does not cause any undesirable side effects...

220006.name: Adepti Seeker's Stove
220006.description: A portable stove that can be quickly set up for cooking in the environment. If you enter into combat nearby, it will be destroyed.\nLiyue's terrain is vast, varied, and at times even inhospitable — and yet all its inhabitants share a love of good food. These two phenomena would not be able to coexist were it not for portable cooking equipment like this. Whether you are scaling the heights of Jueyun Karst or exploring the islets of Guyun Stone Forest, bringing a portable stove means that a delicious and freshly cooked hot meal is always available at a moment's notice.

220007.name: Condensed Resin
220007.description:
You can hold no more than 5 at a time.
Condensed tree resin that can be used instead of Original Resin to revitalize Petrified Trees and Ley Line Blossoms to receive greater rewards.
Crystal filled with immense energy.
The silver-white Irminsul trees and blossoms are connected to ley lines that have become blocked over time. The energy contained in tree resin can purify the obstructing substance.

220008.name: NRE (Menu 30)
220008.description: A handy meal-in-a-pouch that can transform most foods into instantly absorbable nutritional matter. Despite the fact that it can greatly increase the efficiency of nutritional intake, most knights aren't too keen to put their food in it...

220009.name: Anemo Treasure Compass
220009.description: A compass that can be used in Mondstadt to search for nearby treasure and relevant clues.\nThe needle of the Treasure Compass doesn't spin according to the world's magnetic field, but rather follows the energy of ley lines to lead the user to treasure.

220014.name: Mini Seelie: Dayflower
220014.description: A memento from the Lost Riches event. Equip it to obtain a mini Seelie companion.\nA miniature sea-blue Seelie. Unlike other Seelie, it does not serve to guide others, but to follow them to see the world.

220015.name: Mini Seelie: Rosé
220015.description: A memento from the Lost Riches event. Equip it to obtain a mini Seelie companion.\nA miniature powder-pink Seelie. Though it cannot say a word, it will silently follow a traveler that strikes its fancy around the world.

220016.name: Mini Seelie: Curcuma
220016.description: A memento from the Lost Riches event. Equip it to obtain a mini Seelie companion.\nA miniature golden Seelie. It gives off a feeling very similar to that of Mora. They say that Seelie of this color represent good fortune.

220017.name: Warming Bottle
220017.description: Upon use, emits heat for a short period over a small area, diminishing the effect of Sheer Cold.\nWarming Seelie have evolved in response to the extreme change in temperature to give the comfort of warmth to those who seek it. This convenient gadget was originally crafted by those who struggled to survive in the snowy mountains in imitation of such evolved Seelie.

220018.name: Kamera
220018.description: A convenient tool that records and saves images upon use.\nA special item from Fontaine that can record images. People and places to remember must come aplenty for a Traveler roaming the world.

220020.name: Special Kamera
220020.description: When used, this useful gadget can save and store the scenery before it and add a special color tone to it.\nA strange device from Fontaine that will not only record sceneries but will also add special colors to the printed images. This design was made in response to "The Steambird"'s request for a Kamera that could not only reflect the environment, but also the emotions of the one taking the picture. Unfortunately, the final product could not quite match their specifications.

220021.name: Parametric Transformer
220021.description:
A device that can transmute materials placed within and convert them into some other materials.
·During the transmutation process, you must use <color=#3399CCFF>Elemental Attacks</color> to generate enough energy for the transmutation to take place.
·After obtaining the transmuted materials, you must wait seven days to use the Parametric Transformer once again.

This mysterious device, discovered within the ruins, has the power to accelerate cycles and "transmute" material objects. Generally speaking, everything is undergoing a cycle. Memories and elements surge within the ley lines, rotten fallen fruits return to the soil, and the trees born from the soil will one day bear their crystalline fruit...

220023.name: Endora
220023.description: Just a very curious Lochfolk who only wishes to see the world. Might actually get along very well with Mini Seelie: Dayflower, but please do not meld them together, thank you.

220024.name: Windblume Festival Commemorative Balloon
220024.description: Use this to release a balloon that can be popped.\nBalloons have special significance in the land of the wind, for they represent the freedom to drift with the wind. Of course, air pressure will destroy balloons once they've reached a certain height.

220025.name: Windsong Lyre
220025.description: Use this traditional instrument from Mondstadt to play songs.\nAn instrument of incredible workmanship, it will surely produce moving music when played by able hands.\nMondstadt has a long-standing tradition of poetry and song, and thus also boasts a long history of constructing instruments to that effect. Bards are most proud of their songs and poems, and perhaps the instruments, too, would be proud of their owners and their musical tradition.

220026.name: Serenitea Pot
220026.description: A teapot obtained from Madame Ping. There seems to be a whole new realm within it...

220027.name: Wind-Blessed Harpastum
220027.description: A harpastum made from pure bird feathers and strong fabric. Perhaps it contains some strange power...

220028.name: Waverider Repair Toolbox
220028.description: A toolbox filled with all manner of items that can be used to repair the damage done to a Waverider.\n·Restores 50% of a Waverider's structural integrity.\n·Has a 90s cooldown.

220032.name: Electroculus Resonance Stone
220032.description: A stone that can be used in Inazuma to search for nearby Electroculi.\nThis strange device can resonate with Electro Statues of The Seven. Due to this trait, it can detect the presence of Electroculi.\nAcross the span of endless years, even the most majestic cities and sculptures would be worn down by wind and rain, and even the power of Statues of The Seven would gradually dissipate. But this faded strength would coalesce once more into the Oculi, which call out wordlessly to their Statues.

220033.name: Seed Dispensary
220033.description: A special container obtained from Madame Ping. According to her, this dispensary has the power to "generate seeds"... That is to say, it can create the seeds of various plants according to their special traits, which can then be planted within the appropriate fields within your Serenitea Pot.\nPlants available for planting: Silk Flower, Sweet Flower, Cecilia, Glaze Lily, Windwheel Aster, Qingxin, Violetgrass, Valberry, Small Lamp Grass, Jueyun Chili, Carrot, Radish, Mint, Mushroom, Naku Weed, Horsetail, Snapdragon, Lotus Head, Calla Lily, Seagrass, Sea Ganoderma, Harra Fruit, Zaytun Peach, Sumeru Rose, Pluie Lotus, Marcotte, Lumidouce Bell, Rainbow Rose, Grainfruit, Cacahuatl, Saurian Claw Succulent, Quenepa Berry, Brilliant Chrysanthemum, Sprayfeather Gill, Glowing Hornshroom, Skysplit Gembloom, Frostlamp Flower, Midsommar Berry, Lakkaberry, Pine Amber, Winter Icelea, Frostfairy Flower, Flockingweed, Golden Fern, Red Beet, Rimecurrant, Snowball Flower.

220034.name: Electro Treasure Compass
220034.description: A handy tool used to locate nearby treasure in Inazuma and relevant clues.\nThe land of the thundering archipelago has suffered a great many past hurts. The many treasure chests that dot the islands are a symbol of its revival from these wounds.

220035.name: Red Feather Fan
220035.description: Use this to increase Gliding Movement SPD by 30% for 30s.\n\nThis item possesses some sort of mysterious power. In the hands of the tengu warriors, it can have various effects, but in the hands of an ordinary person, it can still have enough power to "make one's body lighter" while in mid-air.

220036.name: Memento Lens
220036.description: A mysterious lens. If you view small fox statues with this lens, you can find things that were not there before.\nThey say that in the distant past, the legendary Kitsune Saiguu left a catalyst for the then-Hiiragi Clan head, Hiroshi, as a tool to be used in exorcisms.\nThe Hiiragis would have a special Kamera made to order from overseas with that catalyst mounted on its lens assembly, before giving it back to the Grand Narukami Shrine as a symbol of their friendship.

220038.name: Mini Seelie: Viola
220038.description: A memento from the Lost Riches event. Equip it to obtain a mini Seelie companion.\nA miniature purple Seelie. Its color is very similar to that of Electro-infused items. Who knows if you might get a little tingle from poking it...

220039.name: Peculiar Pinion
220039.description:
A strange feather.
It may be able to trigger some wondrous effects if used on Tsurumi Island.
Take this feather with you into the world.

You did promise him that you would, after all.

220043.name: Omni-Ubiquity Net
220043.description: A net that has been modified once again by Wakamurasaki using onmyoudou. She claims that it can detain the essence of small creatures before using the net itself as a medium to recreate their forms.

220044.name: Floral Zither
220044.description: A musical instrument that can be used in performances.\nIt is made of rather unique materials, and its craftsmanship is quite different from the designs that are currently in vogue. An unpredictable strength has been woven into the ethereal strings that can even allow it to cause the illusions within the heart of its player to surface.\nThere is an old adage in Liyue: "the longer one's eye of the flower drinks, the deeper one's heart into the mire sinks." It seems that only the strong-willed may use this instrument.

220045.name: Shiki Koshou
220045.description: A gift from Shiki Taishou: a replica armed with spiritual power. Though Shiki Koshou is incapable of charm magic, it is in contact with Shiki Taishou at all times and can share all that it has seen and heard with him, so it's almost like you've still got Shiki Taishou with you on your journey.

220047.name: Launch Tube
220047.description: A special device created by the artisan Pengyi. It comes with functions that allow for the creation and automated launch of fireworks. In the hands of someone creative, it will surely see great use in the creation of unique and radiant fireworks shows.

220048.name: Lumenstone Adjuvant
220048.description:
When equipped in The Chasm's Underground Mines, this precious crystal can provide illumination.

It has many similarities to the Glazed Sand Crystal that may only be found within The Chasm, but it stores even greater power within it.
May it be as a sun in your palm, lighting the way through the lightless tunnels and bringing comfort where all is dark.

220051.name: Arataki's Great and Glorious Drum
220051.description:
A musical instrument that can be used in performances.
A small drum that Itto gave you. He bought it from an outlander merchant, and while it does look quite normal, it is said to be a relic left behind by an ancient and powerful onmyouji who used it to drive out calamity and pray for blessings.
It would cost an ordinary person a large sum if they were to wish to possess this, but the price may be negotiated if one has some connection to the drum.
And wouldn't you know it? An 8,000,000 Mora treasure was eventually purchased for 80,000. What a steal for Itto, eh?

220055.name: Aranyaka
220055.description: Arama handed this book over to you.\nIt seems to have witnessed the passage of many years. By the look of things, someone used to keep records in it, but none of that can be retrieved now.\nUse it to document your shared adventure with Arama.

220056.name: Casket of Tomes
220056.description: A box for cards released by the Genius Invokation TCG Society. Only beginners who have learned the basic rules and are verified as players can collect one.\nThey say that these boxes were made by researchers from the Sumeru Akademiya, and that they feature a special mechanism that can be used to detect nearby people who also possess Caskets of Tomes.\nUse this function to engage in more matches against nearby players!

220057.name: Dendroculus Resonance Stone
220057.description: A stone that can be used in Sumeru to search for nearby Dendroculi.\nA curious amulet of a similar nature to the Dendro Statues of The Seven. By the same token, it is drawn to Dendroculi.\nIn the world, there are grass and trees, vines and flowers — living beings of Dendro Element that abound in diverse shapes and forms. Though differing in appearance and various other aspects, they were born from the same land and will return to the same land.

220058.name: Dendro Treasure Compass
220058.description: A compass that can be used in Sumeru to search for nearby treasure and relevant clues.\nFor some people, the significance of life lies in exploration and discovery. Upon reaching each destination, there is always bountiful treasure awaiting.

220059.name: "The Boon of the Elder Tree"
220059.description: A talisman that can help collect wood.\nTalismans of this kind are often seen in the forests in Sumeru. They possess the ability to gather the power of grass and trees.\nTo prevent the erosion of the forest and, in darker times, to resist the invasion of vicious monsters, trees and vines would form impregnable shelters together. Those who held "the Boon of the Elder Tree" were recognized by the forest as its friends and thus gained unfettered access to walk amidst the forest under the guidance of streams and moonlight. But that is archaic lore from a long, long time ago.
sources: Purchase from the blacksmith in Mondstadt or Liyue

220060.name: Ultra-Hot Burner Lamp Test Model
220060.description: A gadget that improves the efficiency of food processing by consuming minerals.\nYoung Akademiya researchers are accustomed to cooking with their experimental instruments. Someone invented an "Ultra-Hot Burner Lamp" that utilizes the energy of minerals to juice up the heat, all the better to save time and increase cooking efficiency.\nThe one you have is a test model for civilian use with power constraints and a dimmer flame, which should reduce its fire hazard rating. Even so, this convenient gadget is still perfectly capable of cooking jam and drying sausages with ease.

220062.name: Mini Seelie: Moss
220062.description: A memento from the Lost Riches event. Equip it to obtain a mini Seelie companion.\nA miniature green Seelie. It becomes most happy indeed when it gets close to a tree.

220065.name: Fishing Line Stabilizer
220065.description:
A self-adaptive tension stabilizer that can be installed on a fishing rod to facilitate fishing. The device can automatically detect and record how hard different fish struggle. The more data it collects, the better the stabilizer works.

The device's prototype was the pointless invention of a Fontaine inventor that drew little interest for the longest time until the Fontaine Fishing Association discovered it and modified the product into the fishing line stabilizer used today. When the device first came out, it was most warmly received by the Association members, and now it has gradually been promoted in other regions.
It is an exceptionally hot commodity in the Snezhnayan market. Word has it that one of the Lord Harbingers is particularly fond of the product, which explains the hype.

220066.name: Vintage Lyre
220066.description: Use this traditional instrument from Mondstadt to play songs. It may work wonders when played in the forests of Sumeru.\nA vintage lyre borrowed from Amadhiah in Vimara Village.\nMondstadt has a long-standing tradition of poetry and song. Bards from there tend to address their instruments as "Friend" or "Partner." Thus, one of them trusting Amadhiah with the instrument was nothing less than a gesture of intimacy and trust.

220067.name: Jumpy Dumpty Party Popper
220067.description: A party popper that, when used, unleashes streamers and confetti.\n"Jumpy Dumpty is Klee's good friend and fish blasting companion! But if Klee brings Jumpy Dumpty to the festival, Master Jean will be angry... Don't you worry, though! Jumpy Dumpty has gained a new ability with Albedo's help! Just pull on its tail, and beautiful colored strips will come flying out!"

220069.name: Scarlet Sand Slate
220069.description: This object has long been the subject of Akademiya Researcher Tirzad's research. Its etchings and craftsmanship indicate that it is a relic of King Deshret's civilization. It seems to have the power to command devices within ruins associated with King Deshret...

220072.name: Jinni in the Magic Bottle — Liloupar
220072.description:
Born from water lilies, Liloupar, the great Jinni, whose soul had been shattered due to an ancient punishment, was sealed in a transparent magic bottle.
Now, it seems that she has found a new master...

Although she only possesses a-hundred-millionth of her previous great power, she will use what is left of her to help her master pass through the hot sand and ancient ruins of the Desert of Hadramaveth.

220074.name: Cloud Retainer's Damasked Device
220074.description: Made from stacked paper, this lightweight device has the appearance of a bird, and fittingly, was given to you by Cloud Retainer.\nWhile it may be called a "device," you cannot see any traditional mechanical components here — well, not from the outside, anyway.\nIt seems that this adeptus' skills as a mechanist have improved even further...

220078.name: Festive Drum
220078.description: A musical instrument that can be used in performances.\nA drum with a clear sound and unique design. It has an exquisite exterior and features intricate craftsmanship. High-quality materials have been used in its construction, with a view toward sound quality during performances, intonation and long-term wear and tear.\nIt is said that this small drum combines an Inazuman traditional instrument with some quirks of drums from other nations. When it plays certain tunes, it can even bring people good luck...

220084.name: Itty Bitty Octobaby
220084.description: A type of tiny octopus that normally lives in the depths of the ocean.\nPerhaps out of an overabundance of curiosity, or a desire to travel, it begins to cruise throughout the seas while still extremely young. If it sees a creature it likes, it will follow it everywhere.\nBut who knows what it will be like when it grows up...

220086.name: Hydroculus Resonance Stone
220086.description: A talisman that can be used in Fontaine to search for nearby Hydroculi.\nA curious talisman that possesses similar properties to the Hydro Statues of The Seven. It seems to be able to detect the Elemental Flow of Hydroculi.\nOculi are by nature scattered pieces of power belonging to the Statues of The Seven. Returning them to the Statues is therefore the reasonable, right, and lawful thing to do.

220087.name: Hydro Treasure Compass
220087.description: A compass that can be used in Fontaine to search for nearby treasure and relevant clues.\nThese chests scattered across Fontaine are not the lawful property of any individual or organization. In most circumstances, it is legal to claim the contents found within.

220088.name: Crystalfly Trap
220088.description:
A Crystalfly Trap, developed by a senior researcher named Fawitzki from Fontaine Research Institute of Kinetic Energy Engineering.
After being properly deployed and inserting the required materials, this device will start working and lure Crystalflies inside.
Fawitzki once led research on "Low-Temperature Lighting Devices," which required a large amount of Crystal Cores as research materials, which led to the development of the Crystalfly Trap.
However, the project was suspended for various reasons.
"We are here to commemorate the diligent Mr. Fawitzki. We sincerely hope that there are those who will carry on his research. The Institute will provide maximum support in any areas deemed appropriate."
sources: Purchase from the blacksmith in Mondstadt or Liyue

220089.name: Wind-Powered Wind Generator
220089.description:
A wind generating device developed by Refait, senior researcher from Fontaine Research Institute of Kinetic Energy Engineering.
After being activated, this device can provide a strong lifting force for the Wind Glider user.
However, due to design limitations, the device requires utilizing significant wind power to activate. The wind energy required is approximately equal to that produced by the working Wind Glider.
"Umm... So you mean I can only activate this device when I'm already using the Wind Glider."
"But the only reason I even want to activate it is to give my Wind Glider a push!"

220091.name: Portable Aerodynamic Gelatinous Bubble Generator
220091.description:
A mechanism that can be used to create large amounts of colloid bubbles.

Givalois, a researcher from the Fontaine Research Institute, developed this prototype.
The original purpose was to create a large generator of gelatinous bubbles. Just as the project aimed to do, the bubbles so produced could carry some amount of water within them, and move or hover stably in the air, potentially achieving the aim of being able to quickly transport water resources.
However, as they were never able to find a material to make gelatinous bubbles of this type, the project stalled at the prototype stage.
But it is said the researcher Givalois's children loved this prototype bubble machine, so perhaps it would be possible to sell it as a toy?

"This machine is a product of Daddy's research, and it's called the Portable Aerodynamic Gelatinous Bubble Generator..."
"Bubbles! So pretty! Daddy, you're amazing!"

220093.name: "Special Analysis Zoom Lens"
220093.description: A new type of Kamera accessory developed to enhance image recognition capabilities.\nAfter equipping this accessory, a normal Kamera can quickly adjust its focus, allowing it to capture images of your travels so you can record precious memories at a moment's notice.

220096.name: Mini Seelie: Brilliance
220096.description: A memento from Lost Riches. Equip the Seelie to gain its company.\nA mini Seelie with brilliant colors, it can move freely underwater.

220097.name: Nightwind Horn
220097.description: This exquisite horn is a Fontainian instrument that can be used in performances, and was a gift from Dvorak to you.\nThey say the tones of the horn are both rich and mellow as well as gentle, like a gentle evening breeze blowing among a thicket of trees. So, Fontainian composers often use horns to vividly bring the imagery of hunters and forests to life. Without a doubt, this instrument is eminently suited to a musical gala celebrating "life."

220098.name: "Fateometer"
220098.description: A deceptively grandiose-looking card box that is actually quite simple. The number drawn seems to indicate a certain direction of fate, or perhaps the success or failure of a certain choice...\n"As long as you believe in your bond with the cards, the numbers shown will show your fate." — Since Lyney said that, let's just tentatively take his word with a shaker of salt.

220103.name: Pyroculus Resonance Stone
220103.description: A stone that can be used in Natlan to search for nearby Pyroculi.\nDuring its crafting, adjustments were made to imbue it with characteristics resembling those of the Pyro Statues of The Seven, allowing one to sense the blazing power of the Pyroculi through it.\nBy sacrificing oneself, the Pyroculi can be returned to the statue, reuniting the scattered flames. Perhaps the Resonance Stone deems this sacrifice to be worth it.

220104.name: Pyro Treasure Compass
220104.description: A compass that can be used in Natlan to search for nearby treasure and relevant clues.\nAmidst the turmoil and strife that wrack the land, many treasures throughout the vast Nation of Pyro have gone unaccounted for, all trace of their whereabouts lost.

220105.name: Firstborn Firesprite
220105.description: A tiny lifeform that emerged from a flame within a shell.\nThere is something quite endearing about its over-reliance on the shell it found protecting it at the moment it gained its sentience — perhaps it feels secure in this closed-up world. After all, when its eggshell is completely enclosed, it reigns supreme in its own little universe.\nIt is said that in ancient times, the Primal Fire burned with a similar life force.

220106.name: Kaboom Box
220106.description: A mechanism that continually absorbs the force it receives.\nApparently, when the power within reaches bursting point, it will explode in a dazzling display of fireworks. But the amount of force needed to trigger this explosion seems to vary each time... So why not take turns attacking it with your friends? They say that whoever makes it go "kaboom" will have extraordinarily good luck for the rest of the day.

220109.name: Artifact Transmuter
220109.description:
·Consume Sanctifying Elixir to generate Artifacts through the process of Definition, or consume Artifacts to obtain Sanctifying Elixir through the process of Extraction.
·During each cycle, there is a limit on both the amount of Sanctifying Elixir that can be extracted and the number of times that Artifacts of each Set can be defined.

Artifacts draw their power from stories. This explains how it is possible to attempt to create Artifacts through sacred writings. Legend tells of an instance where seventy sages independently produced identical translations of the same source text; and thus, the original text was considered to be sacred. A person has only to place their hand on this machine and the story behind the Artifact will naturally flow out of it.

220110.name: Repertoire of Myriad Melodies
220110.description: A collection of sheet music given to you by Sansa the bard. It contains musical scores and performance insights gathered from various nations, penned in such detail as to rival a musical encyclopedia.\nWith such a collection at their disposal, a musician could play many enchanting melodies indeed...

220111.name: Djem Djem Drum
220111.description: A traditional instrument from Natlan that can be used in performances.\nA percussion instrument with a skin drumhead that can be played with one's bare hands. Tuned using ropes, it has a unique sound that, in skilled hands, can add a rich rhythm to any song.

220112.name: Ukulele
220112.description: A traditional instrument from Natlan that can be used in performances.\nA small, four-stringed lute shaped similarly to — and which plays like — a guitar, though its fret count and tuning differ. Thanks to the material the strings are made of, it sounds clear and bright, yet soft, soothing the hearts of those who hear it.

220115.name: Neo Terminal: Floating Leaf Model
220115.description: A Neo Akasha Terminal mechanism based on an unknown creature, created by a deity who commands all wisdom.\nIts creator ingeniously programmed an auto-follow protocol, intending for it to provide aid to its master anywhere, anytime.\nIn addition, it also comes with the latest timekeeping function, as if to remind its master of their daily agenda.

220116.name: "Lingering Euphonia"
220116.description: A guitar that Skirk made based on the instruments of her homeland.\nThe guitar has a unique charm when played. Its ancient melody seems to hum of a history that nobody recalls.

220117.name: Leaping Spirit Piano
220117.description: Use to play a Natlanese-style instrument.\nA uniquely curved mechanical piano, its black and white keys resemble a traditional model, but the sound it produces is unconventional indeed. On certain lively occasions, musicians play it such that its rhythm becomes the fuel for a fiery atmosphere.

220120.name: Ujola Cat
220120.description: A mysterious mechanical being, much like a cat.\nIt is a gift from the Voynich Guild that was unearthed from an ancient ruin dating back to the pioneering age. According to an anonymous informant, the inscription at the excavation site once bore the word "Ujola," but it weathered away shortly after being uncovered. To this day, the meaning of the name remains uncertain.\nPerhaps it was simply a cat named "Ujola," or it once belonged to someone by that name. Records from the Akademiya show that this name once belonged to a student from Nod-Krai many years ago. The truth is probably simple — after all, it's just a name paired with a cat. What more profound meaning could there possibly be?

220121.name: Rotor Hovering Daybed
220121.description:
The Voynich Guild developed this hovering daybed using artifacts unearthed from the pioneering age.
Once activated, it hovers slightly above ground, allowing you to rest on it anywhere in the wild. A remarkable creation indeed!
Despite the Voynich Guild's best efforts at reverse-engineering, the daybed remains somewhat unstable — the technology of the pioneering age remains unfathomable to this day.
It is said that when the earliest hovering daybed was discovered, it was buried alongside a mechanical cat, leading some to call it the "King Size Cat Bed."
"No! It couldn't possibly be a cat bed. Everyone knows cats don't sleep in their own beds!"

220123.name: Luna Treasure Compass
220123.description: A compass that can be used in Nod-Krai and the Frost Moon to search for nearby treasures and relevant clues.\nThis sublunary sphere holds countless unknown treasures, waiting to be discovered by adventurers with courage or wit.

220124.name: Travel Accounts
220124.description: A notebook filled with various anecdotes and amusing tales.\nOpen it to browse the stories recorded within. With the fortune slip tucked inside, you can also make a simple wish via Destiny Drawn.

220125.name: Lunar Arcana Case
220125.description: A card box given to you by a certain witch proficient in divination. It can be used to store the Lunar Arcana you find during your performances, cards which may also be exchanged with friends in Co-Op Mode.\nEach world defines divination differently, but one thing remains constant — the use of "here" and "now" as anchors to unravel the unknown. Thus, the more Arcana one hoards within this box, the brighter the lantern of understanding burns...

220126.name: The Little Witch's Dictionary
220126.description: Received from Alice, this dictionary was created by the witches. Though it claims to explain a storybook of fables titled The Little Witch and the Undying Fire, it is actually filled with homework tailored by the Hexenzirkel for each reader.\nAs they say, "To defy the current is to learn." Embark on your journey with your companions and seek the crown of elevation!

220127.name: Jadelight Canopy
220127.description: Bathed in the energy of the Ley Lines, the Jadelight Canopy has been replenished with spiritual power. It can now summon a jade carriage, helping its user travel quickly to distant locations.

220129.name: Harmonic Keys
220129.description: A delicate instrument that can be used in performances.\nIn the eyes of the ancient philosopher-debaters, the melodies of the mortal world are but a rough imitation of the universe's symphony. However, the King of the Immortals captured the unusual motifs within the musician's performance, then instructed the harmonist to fix the eternal music onto every key, allowing anyone who plays it to join in the grandest of symphonies.

220130.name: Segment-Domain Treasure Compass
220130.description: When used within the Temple of Space, this device detects nearby treasures and the related clues.\n Even within the hidden vaults where the thousand winds cannot reach, there are still invisible threads that guide the way toward the most precious of collections — as well as the hidden meanings behind them.

220131.name: Linnea's Naturalist Archive
220131.description: A naturalist archive crafted by Linnea herself. It records her observations and discoveries.

220132.name: Sandrone's Portable Tea Table
220132.description: A portable tea table gifted to you by Sandrone. Easy to carry and store, and even fitted with a levitation device. With this, you can enjoy a leisurely tea party almost anywhere.

220133.name: Eye of Graeae
220133.description: A strange mechanism you encountered in an abandoned station. It often appears in the form of a monocle.\nIt seems to have many convenient functions...

220134.name: Witch's Revelation Case
220134.description: The case Barbeloth once carried has found its way into your possession. Within it sleep all the oracles, both those already revealed and those yet to open their eyes. Whether their words may one day steer the course of fate... Barbeloth would only say this: "Hehehe... The true colors of fate are never meant to be revealed lightly. Besides, a future with secrets yet to unfold is far more delightful, would you not agree?"

220136.name: Cryo Treasure Compass
220136.description: A compass that can be used in Snezhnaya to search for nearby treasure and relevant clues.\nMany treasures lie frozen in hidden places across the land of snow. Those who can undo the seals may claim the gifts left within the ice.

220137.name: Conductor of the "Ya-ho"
220137.description: A tiny Jack Frost wearing a hat much like those of the Transport Bureau, driving its own mini train.\nIt is said that when children first encounter fairy tales, the fairies and animals in the stories always act like humans so kids can easily relate. Like a fox sitting at a table for dinner, or a crab running a burger joint under the sea... and so on. So really, a tiny Jack Frost driving its own mini train makes total sense, doesn't it?

220138.name: A Mini Trolley Problem
220138.description: A tiny train carriage that, when opened, will randomly produce either a snowball or fireworks.\nWord has it that a human once posed a dilemma about tying people to opposing tracks and forcing someone to decide which way the train steers... But the Jack Frosts' pranks are nowhere near as cruel as those of humans. "Right" and "wrong" are clearly distinguished, and they even hope that... sometimes accidentally choosing "wrong" isn't such a big deal, as long as you can find a little joy along the way.
